job: Make the staged landing loader dismiss on the browser paint clock and integrate its completed handoff with progressive-meadow release without regressing focus, fallbacks, or Core Web Vitals.

inputs.loaderContract: Ready hold and fade remain visible; meadow promotion beyond the composed opening waits for loader dismissal

required: Ready hold and fade advance on requestAnimationFrame deadlines rather than a starvable timer chain
loader unmounts within three seconds of the meadow-ready state
progressive meadow release begins only after loader dismissal
poster, focus containment, focus restoration, media fallbacks, and static fallbacks remain intact
five cold contexts remain within LCP, INP, and CLS gates

rejectionGates: the loader disappears before the composed meadow is ready
the loader remains mounted more than three seconds after readiness
a fixed sleep is used to conceal meadow work
LCP exceeds 2000 ms, INP exceeds 160 ms, or CLS exceeds 0.08 at p75
reduced-motion, media-error, media-timeout, WebGL-error, or asset-error fallback regresses

commands: npx playwright test --config=playwright.r0.config.ts tests/landing-film.spec.ts tests/landing-vitals.spec.ts tests/visual-system-ui.spec.ts --workers=1
